$comment: The catalog's map. `courses`: where each course sits, x across 0-1000 and y down 0-950. `bridges`: short courses that join two courses, drawn on the line between them. A bridge with no `folder` is in preparation; give it the folder of its course (courses/<folder>) once written. `at` (0-1, default 0.5) moves its card along the line from the first course to the second. `candidates`: courses not yet written, with the icon already made for each (catalog/icons/candidates/, from catalog/icons/icons.json); the page does not draw them yet. Move one to `courses` when its course exists.
